effective_date_reading: No effective-date wording for sec. 3(a); 'The following executive actions are hereby revoked', so the revocations in sec. 3(a), including EO 13583, took effect on signing, 2025-01-21 (printed 90 FR 8634, January 31, 2025). The 'regulatory scheme in effect on January 20, 2025' wording is in sec. 3(b)(i) and concerns the separate revocation of EO 11246 with a 90-day contractor transition; it is the source of the dossier's 2025-01-20 date and does not apply to sec. 3(a)(ii).

targets_in_batch_08.EO:13583: sec. 3(a)(ii) ('Executive Order 13583 of August 18, 2011 (Establishing a Coordinated Government-wide Initiative to Promote Diversity and Inclusion in the Federal Workforce)') among the executive actions that 'are hereby revoked': whole order, no qualifier, no exception, no savings.

conclusion: EO 14173 (signed 2025-01-21, 90 FR 8633-8636, read once in full) states a purpose and policy (secs. 1-2), revokes EO 12898, 13583, 13672 and a 2016 memorandum (sec. 3(a)) and EO 11246 with a 90-day transition for federal contractors (sec. 3(b)(i)), directs OMB and agencies to remove DEI mandates (sec. 3(c)), directs private-sector enforcement planning (sec. 4), guidance (sec. 5), severability (sec. 6), scope (sec. 7) and general provisions (sec. 8). The only transition wording applies to EO 11246; the sec. 3(a) revocations carry no savings, transition or exception clause.
